get.summary: A CSV statement, oldest first, with a total row
get.description: Columns: Date (UTC), Description, Memo, Type, Amount, Balance. Without dates it covers the last 30 days. Text that starts with = + - or @ is prefixed with an apostrophe, so a spreadsheet won't run it as a formula.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day (UTC), included. Defaults to 30 days before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day (UTC), included. Defaults to today.

bankSession.name: pb_session
bankSession.description: Playground Bank session. Set (httpOnly) by /api/bank/login and /api/bank/register.

password.description: At least one letter and one number.

BankProfileUpdate.description: Send only the fields to change.

BankAdminUserUpdate.description: A role, a status, or both.

totalCents.description: Every balance added up, in cents.

openingCents.description: The starting amount: $0 to $1,000,000. Defaults to 0.

amountCents.description: Practice money to add: $0.01 to $1,000,000 at a time.
Money in is positive, money out negative.

balanceAfterCents.description: The balance right after this transaction.

counterparty.description: The other account's number, for transfers.

amountCents.description: Above zero, and no more than the account holds.

replayed.description: true when this Idempotency-Key was already used: nothing moved again.

reference.description: Letters, digits, spaces, dots, slashes or dashes.

amountCents.description: Above zero, and no more than the account holds.

balanceCents.description: What is still owed after this month.

totalRepaidCents.description: Every payment added up: the amount plus the total interest.
